---
title: "Module 12 · Stats and coordinates"
subtitle: "Grammar of Graphics II"
---

ggplot2 computes before it draws (stats), and the frame a plot is drawn in
can change what a reader sees (coordinates).

- **Practice with solutions:** [D1–D4 on penguins](practice.html), the
  patterns behind every Guided Project task.
  Download: [exercises](files/practice_d1-d4.R) ·
  [solutions](files/practice_d1-d4_solutions.R).
- **Class scripts:** `live/` and `concepts/` in your `module-12-stats`
  project in Posit Cloud.
- **Slides:** Slides are on Blackboard and in Posit Cloud (`slides/` in
  your `module-12-stats` project).
- **Guided Project:** START_HERE and `gp12_starter.zip` in Blackboard. You
  work in your own `cis-3901-projects` project and publish your report on
  your own site.

**Readings (optional):** Wickham, Navarro & Pedersen, *ggplot2: Elegant
Graphics for Data Analysis* (3rd ed.), §13.6–13.7, §15.1.1, §15.2.2.
Tufte, *The Visual Display of Quantitative Information* (2nd ed., 2001),
pp. 53–77.
